minimal_decision.adopt_now: No new framework dependency. Reuse AGENTS/Skills/context citations + canonical policy configs + Zod + existing harness/wireguards, tests and requirement/evidence mapping.
candidate_later: OPA after shared multi-adapter policy requirement
promptfoo after explicit offline dataset/report need
one durable engine after real recovery requirement

Treating Markdown, plugin installation or retrieved context as executable authority
Replacing domain transaction/auth guards with SDK approval or OPA availability
Equating CI pass with DIN/ISO certification

solutions.name: GitHub Spec Kit
solutions.machine_capability: Versioned constitution, specification, plan, tasks and workflow artifacts; executable workflow hooks possible when separately configured.
solutions.does_not_prove: Markdown principles and generated checks do not guarantee runtime enforcement, legal correctness, secure hooks or user acceptance. Main README may describe changes after latest tagged release.
solutions.existing_fit: AGENTS, ADRs, contracts, feature verification and tests already supply most artifact roles.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Specify Python CLI and coding-agent integration; generator/workflow scripts are executable supply-chain additions; do not run init over existing root without reviewed diff.
solutions.recommendation: Reference artifact practice only now; no new parallel source of truth.

solutions.name: Fission-AI OpenSpec
solutions.machine_capability: Change-scoped proposal/specs/design/tasks and archive; scenarios make acceptance reviewable.
solutions.does_not_prove: Workflow outputs and AI verify do not prove every task executed or a financial/security policy enforced.
solutions.existing_fit: Existing change/ADR/feature artifacts can link requirements to source and tests without framework adoption.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Node/npm CLI and supported coding-agent files; review exact version, generated prompts and lifecycle scripts before any future adoption.
solutions.recommendation: Alternative to Spec Kit, not an additional framework to install simultaneously.

solutions.name: AGENTS.md + project Skills
solutions.machine_capability: Open Markdown convention that lets supported hosts discover relevant instructions and commands; reusable scoped Skills organize guidance.
solutions.does_not_prove: No required schema, sandbox, universal instruction compliance, automatic scheduler, connector login or host-independent enforcement. Higher-priority system/tool limits still apply.
solutions.existing_fit: Already present AGENTS plus verified SmallBusiness library44Skills; context selector and local candidate staging preserve source boundaries. Six host plugins are not a verified six-runtime repository inventory.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Supported host/context loader; licenses apply to each actual source. agents.md site/repo MIT does not relicense arbitrary Skills.
solutions.recommendation: Keep existing sources canonical; selected context citations, not all-text autoauthority.

solutions.name: Open Policy Agent
solutions.machine_capability: Rego decisions and tests; REST/embedded interfaces; bundles, decision logs and versioned policies.
solutions.does_not_prove: Policy decision is not enforcement; undefined decision, service failure, stale policy and forged input must be denied by trusted adapter. Does not create verified memberships or atomic budgets.
solutions.existing_fit: Potential future shared decision layer for existing typed action gates; current wireguard/harness remains effective boundary, no assumed migration.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Rego maintenance plus local service/sidecar or reviewed embedded runtime; authenticated authoritative context, timeouts, failclosed result schema, policy distribution/log redaction needed.
solutions.recommendation: Defer until at least two runtime adapters need the same policy; first implement narrow deny-default adapter contract and negative tests, do not add OPA solely to look compliant.

solutions.name: JSON Schema2020-12 + Zod + optional Spectral
solutions.machine_capability: Shape/bounds validation when parse/validator is actually called; Zod TS inference; Spectral configurable static API rules.
solutions.does_not_prove: Type inference or schema declaration alone does not run validation. Valid content need not be true or authorized; dialect conversion and format enforcement require explicit tests.
solutions.existing_fit: Zod4.6.7 already pinned; factory OpenAPI validator and dedicated negative gates already exist.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Reuse installed Zod for server inputs/final wire. Spectral would add CLI+reviewed rules/functions and possible remote refs; Docker README discloses startup telemetry opt-out. JSON Schema specification is not a runtime package.
solutions.recommendation: Retain Zod and existing validators; Spectral only if new API style rules have clear uncovered value.

solutions.name: Vercel AI SDK7 tool and approval primitives
solutions.machine_capability: inputSchema validation, ToolLoopAgent bounds, streaming tool states and toolApproval approval protocol.
solutions.does_not_prove: execute tools run automatically by default; strict depends on provider. Approval response/SDK status does not verify approver membership, bind exact action, reserve money or guarantee safe execution.
solutions.existing_fit: ai7.0.153 already installed; model-agent uses Zod final-wire checks, exact1017/high, no fallback, maxRetries0 and a bounded public read tool.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Node>=22; current npm7.0.153 peers zod^3.25.76||^4.1.8. needsApproval deprecated in current official guide in favor of toolApproval; verify pinned package before adopting new API.
solutions.recommendation: Reuse installed SDK; server-owned action/version/tenant/hash approval receipt and domain transaction remain required before side effects.

solutions.name: promptfoo
solutions.machine_capability: Dataset-driven deterministic and model-graded assertions, custom providers and regression reports.
solutions.does_not_prove: Pass rate is limited to dataset/judge; not proof against all prompt injection or a compliance certification. Default/custom graders/providers may cause network/cost/code execution.
solutions.existing_fit: Existing Node/Python tests already cover SDK wire, guards and contracts with mocks. Can export versioned semantic fixtures without replacing them.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Node tool and dependencies; custom JS/Python assertions are executable trusted code, never untrusted model output. Review telemetry/cloud/report handling; no default grader or paid inference permitted.
solutions.recommendation: Optional later offline fixture evaluator; begin with current tests, then exact1017/high-bound model evaluations only with explicit funded contract.

solutions.name: Vercel Workflow SDK / Temporal alternatives
solutions.machine_capability: Durable execution/history, persisted step progress, recovery and timers; Temporal uses replay and worker/service separation.
solutions.does_not_prove: No universal exactly-once external effects, rollback of remote payment, authorization, legal retention or distributed database transaction. A durable record is not successful external delivery.
solutions.existing_fit: Local SQLite staging already uses transactional versions, outbox and exact readback; no RemoteBrain adapter or durable business workflow accepted by this research.
solutions.dependencies_and_operations: Workflow5.2.3 Apache2.0; existing research pins AI7-compatible @ai-sdk/workflow2.0.85, not legacy @workflow/ai5 requiringAI6. Workflow default retries3. Temporal MIT service requires workers/persistence/operations or separately contracted Cloud.
solutions.recommendation: Choose one only for demonstrated long-running recovery requirement; favor existing Vercel path if platform fit proven, Temporal only for explicit cross-service need. Configure nonretry for unresolved paid calls; require idempotency and reconciliation.

normative_boundary.official_statement: DIN use generally voluntary; becomes binding through contract or mandatory legislative reference; context-specific legal judgment still required.
normative_boundary.matrix_status: source-verified planning and gaps, not current rebuilt UI acceptance
normative_boundary.edition_warning: Existing matrix records ISO9001:2026 DIN2026-11 as advance provided and older active baseline; select edition/transition explicitly, not silently promote prerelease.

enforcement_layers.machine_enforced: Path/byte/source-hash boundaries in context selector and staging
enforcement_layers.human_or_runtime_gap: Reading a clause is not executing or authorizing it; context may be partial.

enforcement_layers.machine_enforced: When configured checks run: shapes, allowed refs, source boundary and fixed model configurations
enforcement_layers.human_or_runtime_gap: No guarantee tests ran on deployed commit or statements are true.

enforcement_layers.machine_enforced: Existing guarded code paths validate provider URL/body/model/high/tool shapes
enforcement_layers.human_or_runtime_gap: Must bind every actual entry point, authenticated actor/tenant, funds and committed effects; framework cannot manufacture missing integrations.

enforcement_layers.machine_enforced: Can verify signed/scoped approval action identity, hash, expiry and one-time consumption when implemented
enforcement_layers.human_or_runtime_gap: Business/legal decisions and final acceptance stay with authorized owners; no blanket new permission required for ordinary authorized work.

enforcement_layers.machine_enforced: Transactional domain writes and durable state only within implemented boundary
enforcement_layers.human_or_runtime_gap: External unknown results require reconciliation, not blind retry or success claims.

research_execution.reason: Read-only research; inspected code/test declarations are source evidence, not new test acceptance.
